mapper.select: SELECT m.stage_name, m.avatar, m.introduction, m.id, m.total_fans AS fansCount, m.total_income AS totalIncome, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdTime, u.id AS userId, u.email FROM musician m INNER JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.user_status = 1 AND m.status = 1 and m.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.stage_name, m.avatar, m.introduction, m.id, u.fans_count AS fansCount, m.total_income AS totalIncome, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdTime, u.id AS userId, u.email FROM musician m INNER JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id
INNER JOIN singer_tag_relation str ON m.id = str.musician_id
WHERE u.user_status = 1 AND m.status = 1 and m.is_deleted = 0
AND m.stage_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND str.tag_id IN
#{tagId}
ORDER BY m.created_time DESC

SELECT m.stage_name, m.avatar, m.introduction, m.id AS musicianId, u.fans_count AS fansCount, u.id AS userId FROM musician m INNER JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND u.id=m.user_id AND u.user_status = 1 AND m.status = 1 and m.is_deleted = 0

select m.id, m.stage_name, m.avatar, m.introduction, -- 代表作（取第一首歌曲名） (select mu.music_name from music mu where mu.musician_id = m.id limit 1) as representativeWork from musician m left join user u on m.user_id = u.id where m.status = 1 and m.is_deleted = 0 -- 子查询保证有作品 and exists (select 1 from music mu where mu.musician_id = m.id) group by m.id order by u.fans_count desc limit 4
